title: Behavioral Health Utilization Standard: Readmission Inside an Inpatient Span, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
When the cancellation of an approved Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Prime is confirmed under **Referrals and Authorizations**, a readmission inside the span decides which days count toward the release.

## Records read

- The last day covered by the authorization's latest use: the latest use entry in its unit history (by service date) covers its service date and the days after it, for the days it posted, so its last covered day is that service date plus those days, less one day.
- The patient's most recent emergency department visit, from the patient's TRICARE Prime claim lines (the latest emergency room visit line by service date).
- The authorization's last span day, and the days left on it.

## Rule

1. Where the patient's most recent emergency department visit is dated on or before the authorization's last span day and after the last day covered by its latest use (the patient came back into crisis care inside the span), only the days from the day after that covered day through the readmission day count, never more than the days left; the span days after the readmission are closed for the new stay.
2. Where there is no such readmission, and the span days after the last covered day are fewer than the days left, only those span days count, because days that no longer fit in the span could never have been used.
3. Otherwise the days left count in full.

Where no use is posted on the authorization there is no last covered day, and the days left count in full.

## Cases (hypothetical; span 2 March to 15 March; latest use dated 2 March for 6 days, so the last covered day is 7 March)

| Days left | Most recent emergency visit | Days that count |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 10 March | 3 (8, 9 and 10 March) |
| 2 | 10 March | 2 (never more than the days left) |
| 10 | 20 February | 8 (8 to 15 March, the span days after the last covered day) |
| 5 | none on record | 5 (the 8 span days after 7 March are not fewer than the 5 days left) |
| 8 | 18 March, after the span | 8 (8 span days, not fewer than 8 days left) |
